Makes amount: -1 for all, 1 or 5 by their buttons, any other number through the X prompt. The quantity is confirm ed on the panel before the slot is clicked. Typed amounts are not yet proven on this panel. 1, 5 and All go by their own buttons; All is the one seen working in the test run. An amount that needs the X prompt has not been run here, and on the silver panel next door a typed amount was accepted by the prompt but never shown, so it could not be confirm ed. Until a run says otherwise, prefer 1, 5 or All. W hat true m eans. The slot was clicked. W atch the backpack to know what was m ade. An item the panel does not offer - no m ould, or a placeholder slot - returns false, and the log lists what the panel does offer. Quantity. XPE method.
